title: Ninja SLUSHi 72 oz Professional Frozen Drink Maker, 3 Preset Settings Slushie Machine
features: Innovative RapidChill Technology ❄️: A two-part system spins the auger around the cooling cylinder, freezing liquids quickly without the need for ice, delivering perfectly chilled treats.
Versatile Drink Creation 🍷☕🥤: Transforms liquids like wine, coffee, soda, and juice into smooth frozen drinks with ease. Just pour, select a program, and enjoy!
Consistent Smoothness & Texture Control 🌀: Achieve smooth results in as little as 15 to 60 minutes, depending on ingredients. Drinks require sugar to slush properly!
Sugar-Free Recipe Hacks 🥄: Use recommended sugar substitutes for sugar-free recipes to ensure perfect slushing without compromising taste.
3 Tailored Programs for Every Drink 🍹: Three preset programs with specific temperature settings deliver the perfect consistency for various drinks.
Customizable Texture 🎯: Adjust temperature settings to get your desired drink thickness or thinness.
Quick Fill, Easy Clean 🧼: Effortlessly fill, top off, and clean the machine. Keeps drinks frozen for up to 12 hours, so the fun lasts longer!
Hassle-Free Cleaning 🫧: Dishwasher-safe parts, including a detachable lid and drip tray, make cleanup a breeze.
